Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, anemia, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and low serum protein, with elevated inflammatory markers (CRP, ferritin, LDH), mild liver and renal dysfunction, and abnormal white cell differential. These findings suggest significant systemic inflammation, possible infection or inflammatory process, and multi-organ involvement. COVID-19 PCR is negative. Urgent clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
